resources.title: Unexpected Financial Needs Fund
resources.summary: The university describes a year-round, non-repayable fund for students facing unexpected financial hardship. The page links to the application information.
resources.actionLabel: Check the fund and how to apply
resources.caution: Eligibility and any award are assessed by the university; this link is not an approval.

resources.title: Support for estranged students
resources.summary: The university explains its dedicated support for students without family support, including named contacts, financial support routes, and help with applications.
resources.caution: Eligibility depends on the university's criteria and individual circumstances; do not assume that having no family support alone qualifies someone.

resources.title: Students' Union Advice Service
resources.summary: The Students' Union offers free, confidential and impartial advice on finances, housing, and student life, with a contact form for enquiries.
resources.caution: Eligibility and available support depend on the service's current rules; check directly with the Advice Service.

resources.title: Help with money worries
resources.summary: NatWest explains options for customers worried about payments or accounts, including contacting the bank early and finding independent debt advice.
resources.caution: Eligibility and bank support options depend on the customer's situation; this prototype is not a NatWest service.

resources.title: How to make a student budget
resources.summary: Student Minds explains how to plan for student loan payments, wages and essential costs, and suggests contacting university support when essential costs exceed income.
resources.caution: Eligibility for financial help depends on the relevant provider; this guide gives general information.
